messages:
Carmen Park: Quick thread — were iterating landing copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Outcome needed: hero microcopy, a single benchmark or trust cue per page, two CTA options, and an inbound routing sketch for demos vs self-serve. Freeze by COB Mon.
Theo Nguyen: Ill pull a lightweight tech line for Hosted thats customer-friendly (avoid raw numbers in hero). Also will coordinate webinar tie-in for Hosted demos.
Sam - copy: Plan: 3 hero directions per mode (build, performance, trust). Short sublines and CTA A/B texts. Will avoid repeating existing page phrasing.
Riley (growth): Routing defaults: Hosted -> self-serve; Dedicated -> AE demo queue; Private -> AE + security. Immediate AE if form contains keywords: "compliance", "on-prem", "enterprise", or if company_size > 500. Also tag leads with utm_content=cta_variant for analysis.
Nora (design): We want a micro-benchmark badge variant for Hosted hero (on/off) + control. Badge tooltip needs 1-sentence caveat. Also need two CTA visual styles (primary/secondary) per page.
Sam - copy: Draft hero ideas (short):
- Hosted (developer-first): "Hosted API. Build quickly, scale reliably."
  subline: "Low-latency inference with no infra to manage."
  CTAs: "Start free" / "See benchmarks & demo"
- Hosted (performance-first, badge): badge text: "Sub-200ms 99th on common flows"; tooltip: "Measured on representative workloads; results vary by model and request pattern."
- Dedicated: "Reserve GPU capacity for predictable throughput."
  subline: "SLA-backed pools, configurable autoscale."
  CTAs: "Request capacity" / "Get pricing"
- Private: "Private deploys: VPC, on-prem, and customer-managed keys."
  subline: "Full audit logs and enterprise SLAs."
  CTAs: "Talk to sales" / "Request security brief"
Theo Nguyen: Webinar blurb (Hosted): "30-min: real benchmarks + practical batching/caching tips to lower inference cost." CTA: "Register" and link calendar. Keep copy short.
Riley (growth): UTM pattern: ?utm_source=site&utm_campaign=tri_mode_iter&utm_content=variantX. Mapping: variant with badge -> badge_queue; if utm_content contains "enterprise" -> AE_high. Ill produce YAML after copy freeze.
Sam - copy: Alternate CTA language for enterprise tests: replace "Start free" with "Explore enterprise options" on Dedicated/Private pages for the enterprise-first variant.
Nora (design): For A/B well run: Hosted badge vs no-badge; CTA text variant A vs B; measure cta_click -> signup -> activation. Add event property variant=badge|control.
Carmen Park: Quick routing pseudo-code suggestion to hand to engops:
```
if message or form_text matches /HIPAA|SOC2|PCI|compliance|on-prem|enterprise/i:
  route -> AE + security_team
elif estimated_mrr > 10000 or employee_count > 250:
  route -> AE
elif intent_tag in ["embed","prototype","api-test"]:
  route -> self_serve
else:
  route -> AE_review_queue
```
Theo Nguyen: Can infra confirm a small Dedicated stat for callout? If not, keep it descriptive and link to docs for numbers.
Sam - copy: Final delivery plan: Ill post the full hero lines + CTAs (two variants) in this thread by 5pm PT. Riley will post routing YAML and UTM mapping after that. Nora will mock A/B visuals.
ops-bot: Reminder: copy freeze scheduled at 1795612800 (Mon 23:59 UTC).
Carmen Park: Thanks all. Keep copy lean and testable — we want measurable lift not subtle language shifts. :rocket:
